verdict.rationale: Docs on 'Giving Fin Guidance' and 'Manage Fin AI Agent's escalation guidance and rules' show Fin has configurable guardrail/escalation mechanisms that could support declining out-of-scope questions, but the evidence pack never explicitly documents an anti-hallucination or 'safe decline vs. guess' behavior, nor any test/benchmark showing it refuses invented answers. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of hallucination-prevention/decline behavior, and independent/hands-on verification that Fin actually declines rather than guesses on off-knowledge queries.
